voxy.config.title: Voxy
voxy.config.general.serviceThreads.toolt: Number of threads the ServiceThreadPool can use
voxy.config.general.useSodiumBuilder.too: Uses sodium builder threads as part of voxys thread pool, can reduce stuttering and lag when moving quickly at high render distance
voxy.config.general.ingest.tooltip: Enables or disables voxies ability to convert new chunks into LoDs
voxy.config.general.subDivisionSize.tool: Maximum size in pixels (squared) of screenspace AABB before subdiving to smaller LoDs (Smaller being higher quality)
Enable intelligent LOD subdivision system. Prioritizes nearby and visually important areas for faster loading and smoother transitions
voxy.config.general.render_pressure.tool: Controls the per-frame LOD model build budget. Lower values favor frame rate; higher values catch up faster. The budget also adapts to FPS and queue pressure
voxy.config.general.renderDistance.toolt: Render distance of voxy in chunks
voxy.config.general.environmental_fog.to: Enables or disables voxy rendering environmental fog
voxy.config.general.fog_intensity.toolti: Controls the blend strength of non-shader LOD environmental fog
voxy.config.general.fog_density.tooltip: Adds exponential density to distant fog; zero disables the extra density
voxy.config.general.fog_distance.tooltip: Sets the fog end as a percentage of the LOD render radius
voxy.config.general.sky_fog_distance.too: Keeps sky fog independent from the vanilla render distance
voxy.config.general.shader_shadow_fade.t: Uses a low-cost dither near the vanilla/LOD boundary so shader shadows hand over gradually instead of changing by whole chunks. Only compatible shadow programs without geometry or tessellation stages are modified
voxy.config.general.shader_shadow_fade_l: Width of the shadow handoff band in blocks. Shorter is sharper; longer is smoother
voxy.config.general.vanilla_fog.tooltip: Enables or disables vanilla fog effect
voxy.config.general.render_statistics.to: Enable render statistics in F3 menu, useful for debugging
